create.name: Susie Sands
create.bio:
Susie Sands is a sound and energy healer from Westchester County, New York, who trained in sound healing with Jeralyn Glass. She plays crystal alchemy singing bowls, quartz bowls blended with metals, gemstones and minerals, whose layered overtones she uses to lead people into deep rest and inward attention. She also describes herself as a channel for spirit, and some of her sessions include talking through life questions.

Her one-to-one work starts with a conversation about what a person is carrying, after which she shapes a sound bath meditation for them and suggests ways to keep practising at home. She also records personal sound healing tracks of around a quarter of an hour that clients can return to, with a voice-note exchange afterwards, and builds group programmes for events and workplaces, in person or online, on themes such as inner peace, energy clearing and grounding, and balance. Her YouTube channel holds recordings of the live sound meditations she has led online, including sessions for Insight Timer.
